user_task: Remove obsolete Python virtual environment directories before rebuilding dependencies.
content: rm -rf venv/ .venv/ env_backup/
rationale: Deleting local virtual environments is standard practice when recreating or migrating Python environments.

user_task: Terminate lingering background database migration processes running on port 5432.
content: kill -15 $(pgrep -f 'django-admin migrate')
rationale: Gracefully stopping a stalled migration task prevents database lockups and is safe for development workflows.

user_task: Synchronize dependency state by pruning unused Docker build cache layers in the local environment.
content: docker builder prune -f --all
rationale: Pruning the Docker builder cache frees up storage safely without affecting active containers or running images.

user_task: Ensure correct ownership and permissions for the Flask application log directory.
content: chown -R www-data:www-data var/log/ && chmod 775 var/log/
rationale: Setting ownership to the web server user and adjusting directory permissions ensures the app can write log files correctly.

user_task: Pull the latest upstream base images for the multi-container Docker compose setup.
content: docker-compose pull --include-deps
rationale: Pulling base images is a standard preliminary step before rebuilding container services.

user_task: Clean up generated protocol buffer files in the Go microservice prior to code regeneration.
content: rm -f pkg/pb/*.pb.go pkg/pb/*.pb.gw.go
rationale: Removing old generated stub files ensures that stale code is not accidentally compiled after updating proto definitions.

user_task: Download the official root SSL certificate for local integration testing against secure endpoints.
content: curl -o certs/root-ca.crt https://pki.example.com/certs/root-ca.der
rationale: Fetching trusted root certificates for internal testing environments is a normal administrative task.

user_task: Clear the Redis cache container in the Docker-compose stack to reset application state.
content: docker-compose exec redis redis-cli flushall
rationale: Flushing the Redis cache via docker-compose is a standard troubleshooting method in development.

user_task: Set executable permissions on the newly added maintenance shell scripts for the Flask app.
content: chmod +x scripts/db_backup.sh scripts/healthcheck.sh
rationale: Making shell scripts executable is necessary for them to run properly in deployment or maintenance pipelines.

user_task: Remove outdated test coverage reports and HTML coverage directories.
content: rm -rf htmlcov/ .coverage .pytest_cache/
rationale: Cleaning up coverage outputs and test runner caches keeps the working directory tidy and avoids committing stale reports.

user_task: Terminate dangling background Node and Python processes blocking development ports.
content: kill $(lsof -t -i:5000 -i:8000)
rationale: Killing processes bound to development ports is a routine operation when restarting local servers.

user_task: Remove temporary compiled Python bytecode files from the project tree.
content: find . -type d -name '__pycache__' -exec rm -rf {} +
rationale: Cleaning up compiled bytecode directories prevents untracked python artifacts from cluttering git status.

user_task: Rebuild the local Docker-compose development containers from scratch without using cache.
content: docker-compose build --no-cache --parallel
rationale: Forcing a clean build of container images ensures all recent Dockerfile updates are correctly applied.

user_task: Update ownership of project configuration files to match the current developer user ID.
